Azam Khan criticizes Owaisi and Azad's Muslim-Dalit alliance

Azam Khan, a prominent Muslim leader of the Samajwadi Party, has engaged in a verbal exchange with Asaduddin Owaisi, particularly over Owaisi's "Abdul will lay the carpet" slogan. Khan has also criticized the alliance formed by Owaisi with Chandrashekhar Azad, which aims to create a Muslim-Dalit coalition. Khan, who has recently been released from jail, appears to be taking an aggressive stance against Owaisi and is reportedly seeking to prevent Owaisi from making inroads into Muslim vote banks in Uttar Pradesh.
